Class BaseCommand

java.lang.Object
commands.BaseCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command, CommandWithProgress
Direct Known Subclasses:
FallbackCommand, GarageDownCommand, GarageUpCommand, LightOffCommand, LightOnCommand, MacroCommand, StereoOffCommand, StereoOnCommand, StereoPlayCDCommand, StereoStopPlaybackCommand, StereoVolumeDownCommand, StereoVolumeUpCommand
public abstract class BaseCommand extends Object implements CommandWithProgress
Abstract base class for commands that provides default duration support. All commands can extend this to automatically get duration functionality.
